g.text: Outcomes across the complete example corpus
49 models × 6 exact depths × 2 variants; missing results stay visible. Query limits: heartbeats 200,000, recursion 512; Veil simp default 100,000.
Resource failures are classified by their actual error; phase is retained in the detailed matrices and CSV. Solver timeouts are not UNSAT.
